title: Route Authentication Matrix
purpose: Map all 15 backend route groups to their middleware chains — show which routes use protect, protectAndCreator, protectAndAdmin, optionalProtect, or no auth. Highlight the 2 unprotected referral routes and the missing fan route guard as anomalies.
description: Complete mapping of all 15 Express route groups with their authentication middleware chains, HTTP methods, and security anomalies. Route groups: Auth (login/signup public, reset protected), Users (protect), Creator (protectAndCreator), Content (mixed: protect for creators, optionalProtect for public reads), Subscriptions (protect), Messages (protect), Crypto Payments (protect), Admin (protectAndAdmin at router level), Analytics (optionalProtect for log), AI (protectAndCreator), Notifications (protect at router level), Contests (mixed), Enclave (mixed, public submission), Referrals (protect on 3 of 5 routes), Support (protect + admin for most). Two critical anomalies highlighted: (1) 2 referral routes (/check-milestone/:userId and /validate/:code) have no auth middleware — exposed as internal service endpoints. (2) Missing fan route guard on frontend /fan/* routes — accessible by any role via URL manipulation.

nodes.label:
ANOMALY: 2 unprotected referral routes
/check-milestone/:userId
/validate/:code
nodes.description: SECURITY ANOMALY: These routes have no auth middleware. /check-milestone receives user ID as URL param and returns milestone bonus data. /validate/:code confirms if a referral code exists. Both should be internal-only or require auth.

nodes.label:
ANOMALY: Missing fan route guard
Frontend /fan/* routes have no role check
nodes.description: SECURITY ANOMALY: Frontend /fan/* routes in App.tsx:312-319 have no role guard. A creator or admin can access fan routes via URL manipulation. No frontend-side enforcement.

errorPaths.recovery: User must have admin role assigned
User must have creator role assigned

validationRules: protect middleware requires valid JWT in Authorization header
optionalProtect attaches req.user if valid JWT, does not reject unauthenticated
businessRules: All routes under /api/v1/admin use router-level protectAndAdmin
All routes under /api/v1/notifications use router-level protect
All routes under /api/v1/ai use router-level protect
Referral routes have inconsistent auth—2 of 5 are unprotected
securityConsiderations: CRITICAL: 2 referral routes exposed without auth—internal milestone logic accessible to anyone
MODERATE: Missing fan route guard—any role can access /fan/* via URL
Analytics optionalProtect allows guest event logging—potential for event pollution
Enclave submission is public—potential for spam applications
performanceConsiderations: Router-level middleware applies protection to all sub-routes in one declaration
Per-route middleware chains add validation overhead per request

annotations.text: ANOMALY: /check-milestone/:userId reveals milestone and earnings data. /validate/:code exposes code existence. Both need auth or rate limiting.
ANOMALY: Frontend App.tsx:312-319 defines /fan/* routes without role guard—URL accessible by admin or creator.
